scope: Species in the current Bird Atlas. Habitat summaries mainly describe breeding habitats, not a prediction of where a European vagrant will occur.
text: Original Russian educational summaries based on the linked species accounts. Wikipedia article attribution is retained; summaries and derived reference data are available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
audio: Only per-recording CC0/CC BY/CC BY-SA audio is embedded. Song/call labels follow recording metadata; voice means type not confirmed. iNaturalist recordings require a Research Grade identification matching the species. Xeno-canto links offer further recordings; availability there is not guaranteed.
